title: US News Quiz - Week of September 10, 2026
description: A draft round on the headlines, discoveries, and sporting moments from the United States.

questions.prompt: What was the major new design feature of Apple's iPhone Duo, unveiled on September 9?
questions.explanation: Apple introduced the Duo as its first folding iPhone. It opens into a larger display and closes into a pocket-sized device.

questions.prompt: What did the September 4 U.S. jobs report say happened to payroll employment in August?
questions.explanation: The report recorded a gain of 162,000 payroll jobs in August. This question uses that dated release; later reports may revise the estimate.

sources.label: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, via Department of Labor

questions.prompt: Which American tennis star came back against Mirra Andreeva to reach the US Open semifinals on September 9?
questions.explanation: Coco Gauff recovered after losing the first set and beat Andreeva to reach the semifinals. The question concerns that completed quarterfinal, not the eventual tournament winner.

questions.prompt: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on September 6 to allow new restrictions on which voting method?

options.label: Election Day voting at polling places

questions.explanation: The administration sought permission to enforce new mail-ballot restrictions. This identifies the subject of the dated filing and does not claim the dispute has been finally resolved.

sources.label: Associated Press, published by WPLG Local 10

questions.prompt: Which part of the U.S. coast was hit by Tropical Storm Edouard at the start of September?
questions.explanation: Edouard made landfall in Louisiana near the Texas border on September 1. NASA described rain bands extending across parts of both states.

questions.prompt: Which movie was still leading the U.S.-Canada box office for a sixth straight weekend in early September?
questions.explanation: Spider-Man: Brand New Day remained the weekend leader in the September 6 report. The question asks about the dated ranking, not an eventual box-office total.

sources.label: Associated Press, published by WPLG Local 10

questions.prompt: Which team won the NFL season opener against New England on September 9?
questions.explanation: Seattle beat New England 13-10 in the completed opener. The result concerns a single game, not a forecast for the season.

questions.prompt: NASA's September 8 Hubble-and-Webb announcement described newly found icy objects beyond which planet?
questions.explanation: The two telescopes helped identify previously unknown small bodies beyond Neptune. NASA described them as clues to the early solar system.
